messages.subject: omega reliability Error $ operator not defined for this S4 class?
parts:
Hello,

I successfully ran a reliability analysis of my 2nd order factor model that was fitted using Lavaan. I did this by using reliabilityL2(fit,"MyHigherOrderFactor"). 
Now I want to do the same for a model with only first order factors. I used the function reliability(fit). However now it gives me:  Error $ operator not defined for this S4 class
I did everything just like the examples found here https://rdrr.io/cran/semTools/man/reliability.html

I have no idea what this means or how to fix this. Anyone van help me? 

PS: these reliability functions are part of the semTools packages 

Thanks in advance,

G.
